name: Abel Meholah
overview: Abel Meholah is a city located near the Jordan River, referenced in the context of Israelite military movements and territorial boundaries. It is notably identified as the hometown of Elisha, the prophet who succeeded Elijah, emphasizing its significance in the prophetic history of Israel. The Scriptures highlight Abel Meholah as a geographical marker in Judges and Kings, underscoring its role in God's unfolding plan through His prophets.
